data.long_description:
Experience waterfront living at its best in this large-type 2-bedroom apartment located in Marina Quays North, one of Dubai Marina’s most sought-after low-rise towers set directly on the water. With a generous 1,484 sq. ft. layout and stunning marina views, this residence offers both lifestyle appeal and strong rental potential.

The apartment features a spacious living and dining area designed to maximize natural light and views of the marina. The well-proportioned bedrooms provide comfort and privacy, making the unit ideal for end-users or investors alike. Its rare low-rise, waterfront positioning is what truly sets Marina Quays North apart, offering a more exclusive and serene living environment compared to high-rise towers.

Property Highlights:

2 Bedrooms
Large layout
Size: 1,484 sq. ft.
Full Marina view
Low-rise tower directly on the water
1 Allocated parking space
Excellent rental demand and returns

Amenities & Facilities – Marina Quays:

Fully equipped gymnasium
Swimming pool
Squash courts
24/7 security and CCTV
Concierge and reception services
High-speed elevators
Residents’ lounge and landscaped areas

Prime Location Benefits:

Direct access to Marina Walk
Close to JBR Beach
Walking distance to Marina Mall
Easy access to Tram Station and public transport
Surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and retail outlets

This apartment is a rare opportunity to own or rent a large, waterfront home in a low-rise marina development, offering lifestyle convenience, scenic views, and excellent investment potential.
